nodes.summary: On a smooth Riemannian manifold, the sum $X + Y$ of two Killing vector fields $X$ and $Y$ is a Killing vector field.
nodes.title: Sum of Killing fields

nodes.summary: On a smooth Riemannian manifold, if $X$ is a Killing vector field and $c$ is a real number, then $c X$ is a Killing vector field.
nodes.title: Real multiples of Killing fields

nodes.summary: Two elements $a$ and $b$ of the space of Killing vector fields on a smooth Riemannian manifold $M$ that agree at every point $x \in M$ are equal.
nodes.title: Extensionality for Killing fields

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a Killing vector field on a smooth Riemannian manifold $M$ with Levi-Civita connection $\nabla$. Then $\langle \nabla_u X, u \rangle = 0$ for every point $x \in M$ and every tangent vector $u \in T_x M$: a Killing field preserves lengths infinitesimally.
nodes.title: Killing's equation on the diagonal

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold with Levi-Civita connection $\nabla$. A vector field $X$ on $M$ is a Killing vector field if and only if $X$ is smooth and $\langle \nabla_u X, u \rangle = 0$ for every point $x \in M$ and every tangent vector $u \in T_x M$.
nodes.title: Killing fields via the diagonal of Killing's equation

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold with metric $g = \langle \cdot, \cdot \rangle$. A vector field $X$ on $M$ is a Killing vector field if and only if $X$ is smooth and, for every point $x \in M$ and all vector fields $Y$ and $Z$ on $M$ that are differentiable at $x$,
nodes.title: Killing fields are those with vanishing Lie derivative of the metric

nodes.summary: On a smooth Riemannian manifold, the zero vector field is a Killing vector field.
nodes.title: The zero field is Killing

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a finite-dimensional smooth manifold, possibly with boundary or corners, with a smooth Riemannian metric $g = \langle \cdot, \cdot \rangle$ and its Levi-Civita connection $\nabla$. nodes.title: Killing vector field

nodes.summary: For a smooth Riemannian manifold $M$, the Killing vector fields on $M$ form a real linear subspace of the real vector space of all (not necessarily continuous) vector fields on $M$.
nodes.title: Space of Killing vector fields

nodes.summary: A vector field $X$ on a smooth Riemannian manifold $M$ lies in the space of Killing vector fields on $M$ if and only if $X$ is a Killing vector field.
nodes.title: Membership in the space of Killing fields
